## Checklist

- [ ] `plugins/<id>.json` names the repo, the folder (if any) and a full commit hash
- [ ] The manifest at that commit passes `node scripts/build-index.mjs --check`
- [ ] The repository has the topic `glyph-plugin`
- [ ] I made this plugin or have the right to publish it, and its license is stated
